Name: Town Furniture in Catalogue - Fireplaces fixed
Author: Browswer
Description:
The original mod can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1220]here[/url]﻿, but for some reason the author forgot about the fireplaces. Seems like he is not going to fix it, so i did it by myself.

To use it just install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url] and extract the mod in the Mods folder inside of your game directory.
